chapter: Union career, Masons, mentoring and the Clef Club
title: The Masonic requirement of the Clef Club
summary: Howard says members must be Masons and musicians, and asks that his role in founding it not be recorded.

story.theme_name: The musicians' union: cards, locals, and the Black-white merger
story.community_name: The musicians' union: cards, scale and the black-white merger

blocks.x: In order to join the Clef Club did you have to be invited, or could you just come and say you wanted to join?
No, it's a Masonic club. You had to belong to the Masons.
To get into the Clef Club?
Yeah.
Oh, I never knew that.

That's a little different. Just a little difference. I've got the list of the members here, and I wish I could get it back here and let you see it, who's in the club and all like that, but I don't -- I can't tell you just what they're doing, you know.
Well, once a year now they have a big
program on a Sunday afternoon, don't they, with a lot of music and everyone can come for a very nominal -- isn't it like $3.00 a ticket or something, to go?
Yeah, you can come.
That's once a year. That's not just for members. That's for everybody.
Yeah, once a year.
Uh-huh.
But you've got to be a member. You've got to -- there are certain things that you have to perform in order to be a member.
You have to be a musician too, don't you?
Yeah, you have to be a musician. All those people that I was talking about, they have a memory. When you don't have that, you're --
Who else helped form it, helped form the club when it started?
The club?
Uh-huh.
Nobody.
Just you?
Don't say that. I don't want nobody to know it.
All right.
Just leave it alone. Don't put it in there.
Okay. Okay.

Because I couldn't do what I wanted to do with it, so I just let it alone. See, some people you can't do anything with. You can't do nothing with some people. And stay out of it. I think I've done enough today, don't you?
All right.
Don't you think so?
I think maybe so for today, and we can come back another day when you feel like talking to us again, okay?
Okay.
(RECORDING INTERRUPTION) (Recording furz begins)
